additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0417284-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P0 170001044 ]Charging issue CRM:02698000031
additional_info.body:
Dear Eduard Semiraut,
Hope you are doing well.
We have checked the logs based on the provided timestamp and identified that the charging session was
aborted from the vehicle side
. Unfortunately, there is no indication from the charger side as to why the session was terminated by the EV.
This termination could potentially be due to a communication issue on the vehicle side.
Kindly refer to the session details below, where the session was terminated by the vehicle:
EVCCID:
481693e3143a
2025-04-09T08:02:51.000000+00:00 secc-le [daemon:notice] SECC[1401]: {"type":"stop_charging","timestamp":1744185771299,"chargerId":"secc2300-03789","outlet":"1","outletType":"CCS","payload":
{"source":"EV","user":"internal"}}
2025-04-09T08:02:51.290492+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC] DC1: Charging Phase "
P06_CHARGE" --> "P07_STOP_CHARGE"
Hope you get the clarity, so can we close the ticket now.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
